# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~118 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 11 OPEN. Window 10 shipped to Workshop 3776015553.**

Window 10 carried §74 (blueprint finished art), §75 a-h (wall risers), §76 (Perspective Shift). Full checklist was run: Release build 0w/0e, `Assemblies/` = one dll, PublishedFileId intact, log hygiene clean, committed and pushed as **`afaf614`** BEFORE the strip, six items stripped and restored afterwards, tree verified clean and rebuilt Release after restore. `docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt` holds the window-10 text.

**GIT:** `Astryls/As-above-So-below`, `main`, `afaf614` pushed. Autosave active and demonstrably working.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS NOW A DEBUG BUILD** (post-w10 field tweak §74.b was compiled with plain `build_mod`, which has no `-c Release`; `Source/ModSource.csproj` declares no Configuration). Rebuild Release before the next publish - the checklist already covers it, but the assumption "workspace dll is Release" no longer holds.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** - subscribe-and-load from the WORKSHOP copy, not the workspace copy. Never yet done for any window. (2) **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5: camera-donor was the breakthrough; next attempt uses strip-width sizing units; ⚠ REWRITE kit prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper anywhere: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). The shipped notes promise this. (3) **FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT** (see ledger 3 - §75.h makes this urgent, not housekeeping). (4) §62.N formal line. (5) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (6) §70 Caverns verify. (7) OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED: DesignatorDropdownGroupDefs to collapse the 15 architect buttons into 3 dropdowns; the two §76 shooting residues.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N (positive evidence twice, formal `skip: (none)` line never read), §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ SHIPPED WITH PLACEHOLDER ART:** the 12 riser PNGs, by explicit user decision; the change notes say so in plain text.

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; §75 temp set was an explicit user-ordered TEMPORARY exception; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET - SUSPEND THE OTHER DRIVER INSTEAD. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE - GIVE EVERY STARTUP ASSERTION AN IN-GAME READBACK.

# 74. BLUEPRINT FINISHED-ART LOOK — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

ABBlueprintLook static-ctor retint, Blueprint_ABBuild stuff tint, ABGhostGraphicForLinks IsDoor bypass. The single knob is `ABBlueprintLook.BlueprintAlpha`, consumed in two places: the generated blueprint `GraphicData.color` and `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor` (which must re-apply it on top of the stuff color, or a stuffed plan comes back fully opaque).

**§74.b (w11, post-ship field report):** shipped value 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT in game - dark-wood link art over dark stone has enough contrast at 70% to pass for a finished building, and unlike vanilla we removed the blue `BlueprintColor` wash that used to do the "this is a plan" signalling on its own. Dropped to **0.42**, i.e. below vanilla's own 0.6 blueprint alpha, since our art is full-color where vanilla's is a desaturated wash and therefore needs more transparency to read as equally provisional. ⚠ NOT yet field-confirmed at the new value; if it now reads too faint the fix is that one constant, and the honest next step is a small tint (cool wash at low strength) rather than chasing alpha further, because alpha alone trades "looks built" against "can't see it".

# 75. WALL RISERS — SHIPPED w10 (a-h), USER-VERIFIED, PLACEHOLDER ART

4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment mechanics; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn with its wall; north-face uiIconPaths. **f:** no `researchPrerequisites` on `AB_ColumnBase`/`AB_WallRiserBase` (⚠ per-network toggles still respect each host's research via `AB2_ColumnNeedsResearch`); architect uiOrder links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083 (they had been inheriting DoorBase's 2010).

**§75.g PROBE:** `AB2: carrier probe` (`DebugActionType.ToolMap`). Click a cell: every thing with def/class/drawerType/`IsCarrier`/`ShouldPrint`, an explicit DYNAMIC DRAW flag when a carrier is not `MapMeshOnly`, the foreign print-binding census, and a live **patch census** from `Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods()` + `GetPatchInfo(m).Prefixes[].owner`. Built because four static facts contradicted the symptom and only the game could say which was false. **Keep this tool.**

**§75.h THE REAL FIX.** §75.d aimed at `SectionLayer.TakePrintFrom`; the probe's census showed only vanilla's general layer patched and NOT ONE Dubs layer. Decompiling: `Rimefeller.SectionLayer_ThingsPipe` and `DubsBadHygiene.SectionLayer_ThingsSewagePipe` (identical shared Dubwise code) derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, and override `Regenerate()` to walk cells calling **`Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid(SectionLayer)`**. `DeclaredMethod(layer,"TakePrintFrom")` was always null → silent `continue` for two windows. ⚠ The rule-33 tripwire HAD been firing correctly the whole time, into Player.log only, because it runs before the bridge attaches (rule 40).

Now: patch `<Host>.Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid` per host (DBH / Rimefeller / Rimatomics), deduped by MethodInfo. ⚠ The prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument, because one method serves the normal-view layer AND the host's `*Overlay` layers: it refuses only for layer types in the resolved `NormalViewLayers` set, so anything unrecognised prints and a future rename leaks art rather than hiding connectivity (rule 34, fail-safe direction). `__instance` typed `Thing`, layer bound by index, no foreign type in any signature. A `Census` string records per-host binding, read back by `AB2: network scan` and the probe.

# 76. PERSPECTIVE SHIFT — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

Suspend `Avatar.UpdateCamera` via a parameterless prefix while the viewed band is not the avatar's, rather than out-writing PS (rule 39: our clamp already ran last and that was exactly the problem - the camera settled at our own loose lower bound, `minZ - half*0.5f`, which is the gutter). On transit, snap the camera and NULL `Avatar.physicsPosition`, which outranks `pawn.Position` in PS's target expression and would otherwise drag the view back to the level just left. Freeze via `State.CameraLockPosition` (`ControlsFrozen` is read-only computed); setting `psFreezeAvatarWhilePeeking`, default true, checkbox rendered only when `PerspectiveShiftCompat.Present`; `lockedByUs` guards release so we never clear a lock PS itself set. Cross-band SHOOTING and stair TRAVERSAL needed no code at all: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our existing `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch.
